messages:
Ellen T.: Heads up-- Nimbus Health POC kicks Monday. Need a compact handoff packet for the oncall/integration engineer: hosted API key steps, Dedicated pool request form, and VPC peering checklist.
Noah P.: I'll sketch the hosted key steps. Quick decision: will customer want KMS-backed keys for the POC or does Hosted API key suffice for initial demo?
Rhea S.: They asked for KMS in the RFI but said demo can use Hosted keys if we promise rotation and audit logs. We should prepare both flows.
Tom C.: Dedicated pool provisioning template (use exactly):
```
Subject: [POC] Dedicated pool req <Nimbus-Health>
Environment: POC
GPUs: 2 x a100-sXM (scalable to 4)
Expected avg QPS: 8-15
Primary model(s): instruction-tuned-3B, embedding-ada
Start: <YYYY-MM-DD> 
Duration: 45 days
Networking: customer peering preferred; public egress allowed for fallback
Contacts: sales=<Noah>, eng-oncall=<Tom>, security=<Rhea>
Billing SKU: POCPERF-10%-APPROVED
```
Noah P.: Good. Add a line for data residency and retention policy. They were explicit about EU-only storage for logs.
Rhea S.: VPC peering quick steps (concise):
1) Get customer VPC CIDR + preferred region
2) Open peering request in console -> new peering -> attach to redwood-poc-<team>
3) Share peering-id + add route in their route table for 10.40.0.0/16 -> our peering
4) Ensure SG rules allow outbound 443 and return traffic, and that NACLs permit ephemeral ports
5) Validation: from customer subnet curl to `https://poc-api.rwinference.local/healthz` should return 200
OpsBot: Reminder: tag peering requests with `poc:nimbus` so infra can reconcile.
Tom C.: Security Qs to prep for questionnaire: key rotation cadence, KMS provider list (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), retention windows for logs, role-based access matrix. Rhea, can you prepare the one-pager?
Rhea S.: On it. Will include a short matrix: Hosted keys (fast) vs KMS (requires IAM setup) and sample timelines: Hosted=minutes, Dedicated+KMS=2-3 business days for infra + 1 day for customer IAM changes.
Finance Bot: Note: apply internal promo code POC2026 if POC <= 60 days. Must have AE approval on the ticket.
Ellen T.: Can we also include a tiny smoke test plan they can run post-onboard? E.g., 1) token-create, 2) simple chat request, 3) embeddings latency check.
Noah P.: I'll add curl/snippet examples to the packet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'`
Tom C.: Action items: Noah=hosted key doc + curl examples, Rhea=security one-pager, Ellen=smoke test steps & checklist, Tom=submit Dedicated pool ticket once inbound signed doc arrives.
Ellen T.: Timeline: need packet ready by Friday EOD to hand to the onboarding engineer Monday morning. Post links here when uploaded to the deal.
OpsBot: If Dedicated ticket created, post ID here and create an entry in #release-war-room.
Ellen T.: Thanks team 44d
